scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && bun run check:desktop && bun run check:svelte
scripts.check:desktop: bun run check:main && bun run check:renderer && bun run check:scripts
scripts.check:main: cd apps/desktop && bun x tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.main.json
scripts.check:renderer: cd apps/desktop && bun x tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json
scripts.check:scripts: cd apps/desktop && bun x tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.gate: bun run fmt:check && bun run check && bun run build:desktop && bun test
scripts.native: cd packages/fs && cargo build --release && bun run scripts/build.ts
